messages.message: The compiler command line was rejected before any work started.
messages.cause: Command line or batch file rejected before any work
messages.action: Check the arguments against the usage line printed with the error.

messages.message: The batch file was rejected before any job started.
messages.cause: Command line or batch file rejected before any work
messages.action: Fix the batch file: a non-empty `jobs` array, each job naming its source, cache and resource base URL.

messages.message: A compile option is out of range.
messages.cause: Scope, budgets, threads, base URL or simplification out of range
messages.action: Use a scope of `slice` or `full`, positive triangle budget, thread count and RAM budget, a resource base URL, and `none` or `qem-endpoints` as simplification.

messages.message: The source glTF could not be read.
messages.cause: Source glTF rejected (also a directory with nothing importable, and an `accessor.count` whose dense expansion no machine can address)
messages.action: Validate the file (for example with the Khronos glTF Validator) and export it again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: A JSON file of the source could not be parsed.
messages.cause: Source glTF rejected (also a directory with nothing importable, and an `accessor.count` whose dense expansion no machine can address)
messages.action: Fix the JSON syntax at the position the message names, or export the file again.

messages.message: A glTF accessor uses a layout the compiler does not read.
messages.cause: Source glTF rejected (also a directory with nothing importable, and an `accessor.count` whose dense expansion no machine can address)
messages.action: Export the model again with standard accessors: float positions and unsigned integer indices.

messages.message: A glTF accessor reads past the end of its buffer.
messages.cause: Source glTF rejected (also a directory with nothing importable, and an `accessor.count` whose dense expansion no machine can address)
messages.action: Export the model again; its binary buffer is truncated or belongs to another file.

messages.message: The source folder's `manifest.json` is not marked ready.
messages.cause: Source `manifest.json` not ready, wrong format version, or files changed since it was written
messages.action: Let the tool that writes the source folder finish, or point the compiler at the glTF file itself.

messages.message: The source folder's `manifest.json` has a format version this compiler does not read.
messages.cause: Source `manifest.json` not ready, wrong format version, or files changed since it was written
messages.action: Write the source folder again with this version of Trillion3D.

messages.message: Source files changed after their `manifest.json` was written.
messages.cause: Source `manifest.json` not ready, wrong format version, or files changed since it was written
messages.action: Write the source manifest again, or restore the files it describes.

messages.message: The FBX or OBJ importer refused the file.
messages.cause: FBX/OBJ import failed, or produced no visible mesh
messages.action: Read the reason in the message, then export the file again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: The FBX or OBJ file is in a version the importer does not read.
messages.cause: FBX/OBJ import failed, or produced no visible mesh
messages.action: Export the file again as FBX 7 or as OBJ.

messages.message: The importer ran out of memory while reading the file.
messages.cause: FBX/OBJ import failed, or produced no visible mesh
messages.action: Free memory, raise the RAM budget, or split the model into smaller files.

messages.message: The importer could not read the file from disk.
messages.cause: FBX/OBJ import failed, or produced no visible mesh
messages.action: Check that the file exists, is readable and is not being written by another program.

messages.message: The import produced no visible mesh.
messages.cause: FBX/OBJ import failed, or produced no visible mesh
messages.action: Check that the file holds visible mesh geometry, not only empty nodes, cameras or lights.

messages.message: No mesh instance fits the `slice` triangle budget.
messages.cause: No mesh instance fits the `slice` budget
messages.action: Raise the triangle budget, or compile with the `full` scope.

messages.message: The estimated working memory of the compile is above its RAM budget.
messages.cause: Estimated working set above `RAM_MB`, dense expansion of every decoded accessor counted; also a dense expansion the allocator refuses
messages.action: Raise the RAM budget (`ramBudgetMb`), or split the model into smaller files.

messages.message: An internal check on the finest clusters failed: some triangles belong to no cluster.
messages.cause: Internal consistency check failed on level-0 clusters
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: An internal check on the finest clusters failed: a cluster is malformed.
messages.cause: Internal consistency check failed on level-0 clusters
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A cluster's simplification error is above its parent's, which would break level-of-detail selection.
messages.cause: A cluster's error above its parent's, or a coarse cluster's normal deviation past its group's bound ([checks](COMPILER.md#invocation))
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A coarse cluster bends its normals past its group's bound.
messages.cause: A cluster's error above its parent's, or a coarse cluster's normal deviation past its group's bound ([checks](COMPILER.md#invocation))
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A cluster's parents span more bundles than the dependency bound allows.
messages.cause: A cluster whose parents alone span more bundles than `streams.dependencyBound` ([bundles](COMPILER.md#invocation)); names the mesh, the primitive and the page
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the mesh and primitive the message names.

messages.message: A bundle's dependency list failed its consistency check.
messages.cause: A bundle dependency list with a cycle, missing its pages' parents, not closed, not reaching the root cover, or not empty on a pinned bundle; the message names the mesh and the primitive, then the page or the bundle ([bundles](COMPILER.md#invocation))
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the mesh, primitive and page the message names.

messages.message: The compile stopped on a cancel request; nothing was published.
messages.cause: Stopped on a cancel request
messages.action: Run the compile again when you want its result.

messages.message: Another compile holds the cache folder's lock.
messages.cause: Another compilation holds `<cache>/native/.lock`, an operating-system file lock held for the whole compile. It follows the process, not the file: released when its owner ends, killed or not, so no cache stays blocked; the file is never deleted, only the hold counts. The newcomer waits 30 s (`TRILLION3D_CACHE_LOCK_WAIT_MS`) before this refusal; a cancel during the wait ends it with `CANCELLED`
messages.action: Wait for the other compile to end, or compile into another cache folder; `TRILLION3D_CACHE_LOCK_WAIT_MS` sets how long to wait.

messages.message: A file could not be read or written.
messages.cause: Filesystem or thread pool failure
messages.action: Check the free disk space and the permissions of the source and cache folders.

messages.message: The compiler could not start its worker threads.
messages.cause: Filesystem or thread pool failure
messages.action: Lower the thread count, or free system resources, then compile again.

messages.message: The standalone glTF scene was not written because the source is animated.
messages.cause: The source declares node animation, skinning or morph weights, which the autonomous glTF (accessors rebuilt from the cache's pages) cannot carry: the mode is refused for this cache (`autonomousScene: null`) rather than written frozen. Once per job; does not fail the job
messages.action: Load the cache through the engine, which plays the animation; the standalone scene serves static models only.

messages.message: A baked texture level could not be written, so the engine loads the source image instead.
messages.cause: A baked mip level could not be written under `native/textures/` (disk full, directory not writable); the entry keeps its sidecar tail with `bakedLevels = 0`, so the engine loads the source image. Per image; does not fail the job
messages.action: Free disk space or make the cache folder writable, then compile again.

messages.message: The source animation uses a feature the importer does not carry.
messages.cause: An FBX skin, curve or keyed channel outside what the glTF intermediate carries (for example several skin deformers on one mesh); refused rather than frozen.
messages.action: Bake the animation to plain keyframes in the authoring tool and export again.

messages.message: A glTF index points outside its accessor.
messages.cause: A triangle index, or a sparse accessor index, at or past the count of the accessor it indexes.
messages.action: Export the model again; its index or sparse accessor data is corrupt.

messages.message: A glTF accessor has a missing or unknown type.
messages.cause: An accessor `type` absent, or outside the ones glTF defines for the attribute that reads it.
messages.action: Export the model again with standard accessor types (`SCALAR`, `VEC2`, `VEC3`, `VEC4`, `MAT4`).

messages.message: A glTF accessor has a component type the compiler does not read.
messages.cause: An accessor `componentType` outside the glTF list, or not allowed for the attribute that reads it.
messages.action: Export the model again with float, normalised integer or unsigned integer components.

messages.message: A glTF primitive is not made of triangles.
messages.cause: A primitive `mode` other than triangles (points, lines, strips or fans the reader does not expand).
messages.action: Triangulate the mesh in its authoring tool; points and lines are not drawn.

messages.message: A primitive's index count is not a positive multiple of three.
messages.cause: A triangle list whose index count is zero or not divisible by three.
messages.action: Export the model again; its triangle list is truncated.

messages.message: A vertex position is not a finite number.
messages.cause: A position component that is NaN or infinite; no bounds or clusters can be built from it.
messages.action: Clean the mesh in its authoring tool (remove NaN or infinite vertices) and export again.

messages.message: The source is missing a file it needs.
messages.cause: A source whose runtime glTF is absent, or a compressed buffer that does not decode.
messages.action: Point the compiler at a folder or file holding the whole model, its runtime file included.

messages.message: No import driver accepts this source.
messages.cause: A file or folder whose extension and content no scene driver claims.
messages.action: Use one of the accepted formats the message lists, or convert the model to glTF.

messages.message: Several import drivers claim the same source folder.
messages.cause: A source directory holding files of several scene formats, none preferred.
messages.action: Keep one model format per source folder, or point the compiler at the file itself.

messages.message: A compiled manifest failed its format check.
messages.cause: A binary manifest record whose length, count or layout contradicts its header.
messages.action: Delete the cache folder and compile again.

messages.message: A geometry page has an invalid triangle or vertex count.
messages.cause: A page whose triangle or position count is zero or past its limit, found while encoding it.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A geometry page attribute has an invalid count or layout.
messages.cause: A page attribute whose count or layout does not match the page it belongs to.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A page attribute spans more than its quantisation grid can hold.
messages.cause: An attribute range past 2^24 steps of its primitive's grid.
messages.action: Split the mesh, or scale its UVs or attributes down to a smaller range, then compile again.

messages.message: A geometry page holds more than 65,535 vertices.
messages.cause: A page past the 16-bit vertex index its format uses.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A skinned page names a joint past 65,535.
messages.cause: A joint index past the 16-bit range a page stores.
messages.action: Reduce the skeleton to at most 65,536 joints and export again.

messages.message: A primitive has more morph targets than a page carries.
messages.cause: A primitive's morph target count past the per-page limit.
messages.action: Reduce the primitive's morph targets and export again.

messages.message: A simulated primitive also carries a skin or morph targets.
messages.cause: A cloth, rope or soft-volume primitive that also declares joints or morph targets.
messages.action: Keep one deformation per primitive: either the physics simulation, or the skin and morph targets.

messages.message: The physics shape of a primitive could not be built.
messages.cause: The native physics cook refused a primitive's collision or soft-body shape.
messages.action: Check the mesh for degenerate or non-manifold parts, clean it, and compile again.

messages.message: A baked texture level could not be encoded.
messages.cause: The lossless encoder refused a texture level baked from a decoded image.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the texture if you can share it.

messages.message: The world's pinned top level is above its byte budget.
messages.cause: The always-resident top of a world holds more bytes than its budget; the message names the heaviest cell.
messages.action: Split the world into more cells, or simplify the objects that stay loaded everywhere.

messages.message: The cutout answer sheet in the cache folder is invalid.
messages.cause: An answer sheet whose JSON, version or entries do not read back.
messages.action: Fix or delete the answer sheet (`decoupes.json`), then compile again.

messages.message: The reference path tracer's job file is invalid.
messages.cause: A `trillion3d-oracle` job missing a field or holding a value out of range (a measurement tool, not the compiler).
messages.action: Fix the job file at the field the message names.

messages.message: The reference path tracer's scene is invalid.
messages.cause: A `trillion3d-oracle` scene missing a field or holding a value out of range (a measurement tool, not the compiler).
messages.action: Fix the scene at the field the message names.

messages.message: A primitive of several clusters built no coarser level, so it is drawn at full detail at every distance.
messages.cause: The cluster DAG of the primitive stopped at depth 0: every group of clusters failed to simplify (seam-locked, border-locked, too small or of unusable error); the warning carries the group count per outcome and the dominant cause.
messages.action: Look at the named cause in `clusters.json`: weld seams, remove locked borders or split UV islands in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A primitive's DAG stopped rising mid-way and left many roots, so it stays heavy in the distance.
messages.cause: More than an eighth of a primitive's pages are roots, on a primitive of at least eight clusters: its DAG stopped mid-way.
messages.action: Look at the named cause in `clusters.json`: weld seams, remove locked borders or split UV islands in the authoring tool.

messages.message: An archive entry's path leaves the extraction folder.
messages.cause: ZIP entry path leaves the extraction root (absolute path, `..`, named volume, reversed separator)
messages.action: Rebuild the archive with relative entry paths only.

messages.message: An archive entry is a symbolic link, which is never followed.
messages.cause: ZIP entry is a symlink; never followed
messages.action: Rebuild the archive with the linked files stored as plain files.

messages.message: An archive entry is encrypted.
messages.cause: ZIP entry is encrypted; refused, never bypassed
messages.action: Rebuild the archive without encryption.

messages.message: The archive is truncated or corrupted.
messages.cause: ZIP archive truncated or corrupted
messages.action: Download or export the archive again.

messages.message: The archive holds no entry.
messages.cause: ZIP archive carries no entry
messages.action: Check that the archive holds the model files.

messages.message: The archive holds more than 20,000 entries.
messages.cause: ZIP archive exceeds 20,000 entries
messages.action: Split the archive, or extract it and compile the model folder.

messages.message: The archive unpacks to more than 8 GiB.
messages.cause: ZIP archive exceeds 8 GiB decompressed
messages.action: Extract the archive and compile the model folder, or split the model.

messages.message: A node names a light the file does not declare, so that light is left out.
messages.cause: A node names a `KHR_lights_punctual` light the document does not declare; the lamp is left out
messages.action: Export the scene again; its light list is inconsistent.

messages.message: A light's position or orientation is not a finite number, so the light is left out.
messages.cause: The lamp's world matrix holds a non-finite number
messages.action: Fix the light's transform in the authoring tool and export again.

messages.message: A light is neither point, spot nor directional, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A lamp neither `point`, `spot` nor `directional`
messages.action: Replace it with a point, spot or directional light.

messages.message: A light's intensity is zero, negative or not a number, so it is left out.
messages.cause: Intensity zero, negative or non-finite
messages.action: Give the light a positive intensity.

messages.message: A spot or directional light has a transform that collapses its direction, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A `spot` or `directional` lamp whose node transform collapses its −Z axis
messages.action: Fix the light's rotation and scale in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A light's emitter radius was measured on its emissive body rather than read from the file.
messages.cause: Counted, not rejected: `emitterRadius` measured on the emissive body bound to the lamp, not read from the source
messages.action: Nothing to do; declare the radius in the file to choose it yourself.

messages.message: A light's emitter radius is not usable, so it is omitted and the light kept.
messages.cause: A radius, declared or measured, not finite, not strictly positive, or not strictly below `range`; the field is omitted, the lamp kept
messages.action: Give the light a positive radius smaller than its range.

messages.message: An area or volume light was left out; only point, spot and directional lights are carried.
messages.cause: An FBX or OBJ light of the area or volume type, which has no glTF punctual equivalent.
messages.action: Replace it with point, spot or directional lights, or with an emissive surface.

messages.message: A material library the model cites could not be opened, so its materials take default values.
messages.cause: A cited material library (an OBJ `mtllib`) could not be opened; every material takes its defaults
messages.action: Place the `.mtl` file beside the model under the name the model cites.

messages.message: The material library ends in the middle of a declaration.
messages.cause: The material library's last line is unterminated, cut mid-declaration; the incomplete value parsed is kept
messages.action: Export the `.mtl` file again; the last value read is kept.

messages.message: A specular colour or map was dropped; glTF's metal-roughness model has no place for it.
messages.cause: A specular colour or map (`Ks`, `map_Ks`), which glTF's metallic-roughness model has no room for; **not** turned into metalness, a different model
messages.action: Convert the material to metal-roughness in the authoring tool.

messages.message: An index of refraction other than 1.5 was dropped.
messages.cause: An index of refraction (`Ni`) other than glTF's default 1.5
messages.action: Nothing carries it in glTF; set the look with roughness and metalness instead.

messages.message: An ambient colour or map was dropped; glTF has no ambient term.
messages.cause: An ambient colour or map (`Ka`, `map_Ka`) that became neither the occlusion nor the base-colour texture; glTF has no ambient term
messages.action: Bake the ambient into the base colour or an occlusion map.

messages.message: A bump map was dropped because a different normal map is kept.
messages.cause: A bump map (`bump`, `map_Bump`) naming another file than the normal map kept; the normal map wins and the height map is dropped
messages.action: Bake the bump into the normal map, or keep only one of them.

messages.message: An opacity map separate from the base colour was dropped; glTF reads opacity from the base colour's alpha only.
messages.cause: An FBX or OBJ opacity map naming another image than the base colour.
messages.action: Put the opacity into the alpha channel of the base-colour texture.

messages.message: Metalness and roughness come from different maps, which glTF cannot carry.
messages.cause: An FBX or OBJ material whose metalness and roughness maps are two files; neither is bound.
messages.action: Pack metalness and roughness into one texture (blue and green channels).

messages.message: A texture map's offset option was dropped.
messages.cause: A map's `-o` or `-s` option; would need `KHR_texture_transform`, which the glTF writer does not emit
messages.action: Bake the offset into the UVs in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A texture map's scale option was dropped.
messages.cause: A map's `-o` or `-s` option; would need `KHR_texture_transform`, which the glTF writer does not emit
messages.action: Bake the scale into the UVs in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A bump map's strength option was dropped; glTF carries no relief strength.
messages.cause: A map's `-bm` option; glTF carries no relief strength
messages.action: Bake the strength into the normal map.

messages.message: An embedded texture is in an image format the importer does not read, so it is dropped.
messages.cause: An FBX texture carried inside the file whose name gives no supported image format.
messages.action: Embed the texture as PNG or JPEG, or place it beside the model.

messages.message: A texture file is in an image format the importer does not read, so it is dropped.
messages.cause: A referenced texture file whose extension no image driver claims.
messages.action: Convert the texture to PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: A texture file the model cites was not found, so the material draws without it.
messages.cause: A referenced texture file absent from the source folder.
messages.action: Place the texture beside the model under the name the model cites.

messages.message: A texture file lies outside the model's folder, so it is not copied.
messages.cause: A referenced texture path leaving the source folder.
messages.action: Move the texture into the model's folder and point the material at it.

messages.message: A procedural texture was dropped; only image textures are carried.
messages.cause: An FBX or OBJ texture with no image file behind it.
messages.action: Bake the procedural texture to an image in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A texture's UV transform was dropped.
messages.cause: An FBX texture with a translation, rotation or scale on its UVs, which the glTF writer does not carry.
messages.action: Bake the transform into the UVs in the authoring tool.

messages.message: Hidden nodes were left out of the scene.
messages.cause: FBX or OBJ nodes marked invisible in the source; counted, not converted.
messages.action: Make the nodes visible in the authoring tool if they should be drawn.

messages.message: A node's transform is not a finite number, so the node is left out.
messages.cause: A node whose world matrix holds NaN or infinity.
messages.action: Fix the node's transform in the authoring tool and export again.

messages.message: The file is not a readable Blender file.
messages.cause: File starts neither with `BLENDER` nor with a gzip or Zstandard frame, or its header does not read back
messages.action: Save the file again from Blender.

messages.message: The Blender file was written with 32-bit pointers.
messages.cause: Written with 32-bit pointers; only 64-bit files are read
messages.action: Open the file in a 64-bit Blender and save it again.

messages.message: The Blender file is big-endian.
messages.cause: Big-endian; only little-endian files are read
messages.action: Open the file in a current Blender and save it again.

messages.message: The Blender file uses a block layout this reader does not know.
messages.cause: A block-header variant outside the one this reader describes
messages.action: Save the file again from a current Blender, or export it to glTF.

messages.message: The Blender file ends in the middle of a block.
messages.cause: The file, or its compressed frame, ends inside a block
messages.action: Save the file again from Blender; the copy is incomplete.

messages.message: The Blender file needs more memory than the RAM budget.
messages.cause: Needs more than the job's `ramBudgetMb`: a gzip or Zstandard file unpacking past it (the message names the least bytes needed), a block index not fitting in what is left, or a packed image or mesh taking the scene binary past it (named, with its bytes); a bare file is mapped in place, its size never counted. Also a mesh announcing more vertices or corners than this reader reads
messages.action: Raise the RAM budget, or split the scene into smaller files.

messages.message: The Blender file's structure description is missing or unreadable.
messages.cause: No `DNA1` block, or its self-description does not read back
messages.action: Save the file again from Blender.

messages.message: A Blender mesh is stored in a layout this reader does not know.
messages.cause: A mesh in none of the known layouts — Blender 5's attribute store, the `CustomData` layers of 3.5 to 4.x, the `MVert`/`MPoly`/`MLoop` structures of 2.8 to 3.4 — (no `position`, no `.corner_vert`, or unreadable face offsets); refused, never guessed
messages.action: Save the file again from a current Blender, or export it to glTF.

messages.message: A Blender mesh corner points outside its vertices.
messages.cause: A mesh corner points outside its own vertices
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in Blender (Merge by Distance, Delete Loose) and save again.

messages.message: An object that instances a collection was left out.
messages.cause: An object instancing a collection; per object, does not fail the job
messages.action: Make the instance real in Blender (Object > Apply > Make Instances Real).

messages.message: Modifiers were not applied; the base mesh is exported.
messages.cause: Modifiers, evaluated by Blender and not stored: the base mesh is exported
messages.action: Apply the modifiers in Blender before saving.

messages.message: A mesh object points at no mesh data, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A mesh object pointing at non-mesh data, or nothing
messages.action: Fix or delete the object in Blender.

messages.message: An alpha input from another image or node was dropped; the declared alpha is kept.
messages.cause: `Alpha` from an image the base colour does not carry, or a computed node; glTF reads opacity only from the base-colour texture's alpha, so the declared factor is kept
messages.action: Put the alpha into the base-colour image's alpha channel.

messages.message: An alpha taken from a colour channel was dropped; the declared alpha is kept.
messages.cause: `Alpha` from a channel of the base-colour image other than its alpha; reading it there would recompose bytes, so the declared factor is kept
messages.action: Store the alpha in the base-colour image's alpha channel.

messages.message: A material not driven by a Principled BSDF keeps only its basic values.
messages.cause: The active `Material Output` is driven by something other than a `Principled BSDF`, or nothing; the material block's own values are kept
messages.action: Connect a Principled BSDF to the material output.

messages.message: A shader input fed by a node other than an image was not converted; its declared value is kept.
messages.cause: A Principled BSDF input fed by a node other than an image texture (or a normal map over one); the declared value is kept exactly
messages.action: Bake the node setup to an image texture in Blender.

messages.message: An emission above 1 was clamped.
messages.cause: Emission colour × strength above 1, which `emissiveFactor` cannot carry; clamped
messages.action: Lower the emission strength, or accept the clamp.

messages.message: An image in a format the image readers do not decode was dropped.
messages.cause: An image file the image registry cannot decode; the scene continues without it
messages.action: Convert the image to PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: An image outside the model's folder, not packed, was not copied.
messages.cause: An image outside the served root with no packed bytes; not copied beside the scene
messages.action: Pack the image in Blender, or move it into the model's folder.

messages.message: An object's material override was dropped; the mesh's own material is kept.
messages.cause: An object replacing a mesh material slot; the mesh's material is kept
messages.action: Assign the material to the mesh data instead of the object.

messages.message: A polygon could not be cut into triangles cleanly and was filled as a fan.
messages.cause: A face the ear-clipping cut could not finish ([Polygon faces](COMPILER.md#polygon-faces)): self-crossing, or planeless (every corner collinear, zero area); it falls back to the fan from its first corner, which may overfill its outline
messages.action: Triangulate or fix the face in Blender (self-crossing or flat polygon).

messages.message: The file holds more than one scene; only the active one is exported.
messages.cause: More than one scene; only the active scene's objects are exported
messages.action: Make the scene you want active before saving.

messages.message: A mesh object outside the active scene was not exported.
messages.cause: A mesh object no collection of the active scene holds — left over, in another scene, or in a collection the active view layer excludes; not exported
messages.action: Link the object into a collection of the active scene if it should be drawn.

messages.message: A light type other than point, sun, spot or area was left out.
messages.cause: A lamp type not converted — the `hemi` of files before Blender 2.8, or any type outside point, sun, spot and area; not exported
messages.action: Replace it with a point, sun, spot or area light.

messages.message: A light object points at no light data, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A lamp object pointing at non-`Lamp` data, or nothing; not exported
messages.action: Fix or delete the object in Blender.

messages.message: A lossy WebP texture was refused, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: A WebP `VP8 ` (lossy) stream, refused before decoding: the fidelity policy admits WebP lossless only
messages.action: Save the texture as lossless WebP or PNG.

messages.message: An animated WebP or GIF texture was refused, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: An `ANIM`/`ANMF` chunk (WebP) or a second image descriptor (GIF): an animation is not a texture, refused rather than flattened to a chosen frame
messages.action: Export the one frame you want as a still image.

messages.message: An animated PNG was read as its default image only.
messages.cause: A PNG `acTL` chunk (an APNG of several frames): the default image, the one the APNG specification places in `IDAT`, is delivered and the animation counted
messages.action: Nothing to do if the default image is the one you want; otherwise save that frame as PNG.

messages.message: An embedded colour profile was ignored; the texture is read as sRGB.
messages.cause: An embedded colour profile — PNG `iCCP`, JPEG `ICC_PROFILE` APP2 segment, Photoshop image resource 1039 — that the sRGB output, with no colour management, does not carry; a profile naming itself sRGB counts nothing
messages.action: Convert the texture to sRGB in an image editor.

messages.message: A PNG gamma other than sRGB or linear was ignored; the texture is read as sRGB.
messages.cause: A PNG `gAMA` neither 45455 (sRGB) nor 100000 (linear), with no `iCCP` or `sRGB` chunk overriding it; treated as sRGB, the convention for a silent file
messages.action: Convert the texture to sRGB in an image editor.

messages.message: A TIFF profile or codec was declined, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: TIFF read, its profile or codec declined
messages.action: Save the texture as PNG, or as an uncompressed 8-bit TIFF.

messages.message: A texture with more than 8 bits per channel was refused, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: A bit depth the `Rgba8` contract cannot carry (PNG or TIFF 16 bits per channel, DDS 16-bit codecs); refused before decoding rather than narrowed to 8 bits
messages.action: Save the texture at 8 bits per channel.

messages.message: A texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Over the allocation ceiling once expanded to RGBA8 (width x height x 4, checked before any pixel is decoded); decoded by no `image`-crate plugin
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: A floating-point image (OpenEXR or HDR) was used where an 8-bit image is expected.
messages.cause: The `RgbaF32` variant (OpenEXR, Radiance HDR) returned to an `Rgba8`-only consumer (the RGBA8 sRGB previews); refused by name rather than tone-mapped
messages.action: Convert the texture to an 8-bit PNG.

messages.message: A BMP bit depth outside the lossless list was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A BMP bit count outside those carried losslessly to RGBA8 (1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 24, 32)
messages.action: Save the texture as PNG.

messages.message: A BMP with more than 8 bits per channel was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A `BI_BITFIELDS` mask wider than eight bits per channel (10-10-10, for instance), which decoding would narrow; refused before decoding
messages.action: Save the texture as PNG.

messages.message: A BMP wrapping a JPEG or PNG was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: `BI_JPEG` or `BI_PNG`: another format wrapped, which has its own plugin; unwrapping it here would bypass the router
messages.action: Save the texture as a plain JPEG or PNG file.

messages.message: A BMP compression outside the read list was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A compression outside the read format (`BI_ALPHABITFIELDS`, the CMYK variants)
messages.action: Save the texture as PNG.

messages.message: A DDS texture's header is truncated, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Shorter than `DDS_HEADER`/`DDS_PIXELFORMAT`/`DDS_HEADER_DXT10` require
messages.action: Export the DDS texture again.

messages.message: A DDS texture's header is out of range, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Header out of domain (false announced size, zero dimension, absurd mip count)
messages.action: Export the DDS texture again.

messages.message: A DDS codec outside the read list was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A codec outside the declared list (BC6H float, signed variants, `_TYPELESS`, 16-bit, YUV, premultiplied-alpha `DXT2`/`DXT4`)
messages.action: Export the texture as BC1 to BC7 (8-bit), or as PNG.

messages.message: A DDS cube, volume, array or padded texture was refused, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Not a plain surface (cube, volume, array, padded row pitch)
messages.action: Export a plain 2D texture.

messages.message: A DDS texture's pixel data is incomplete, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Consistent header, announced pixels missing
messages.action: Export the DDS texture again.

messages.message: A DDS texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Over the decoder's allocation ceiling
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: An OpenEXR texture's header is unreadable, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: OpenEXR magic present, version field or header unreadable
messages.action: Export the OpenEXR file again.

messages.message: A deep OpenEXR image was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Deep data (a list of samples per pixel); flattening it would be a compositing choice
messages.action: Flatten the image to a plain OpenEXR in the compositing tool.

messages.message: A multi-part OpenEXR image was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Several parts; nothing says which is the texture
messages.action: Export the part you want as a single-part OpenEXR.

messages.message: OpenEXR channels other than R, G, B and A were refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Channels other than `R`, `G`, `B` plus optional `A` — extra or other names, 32-bit integers, subsampling
messages.action: Export the image with R, G, B and optional A channels only.

messages.message: An OpenEXR texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Over the allocation ceiling, counted at 16 bytes per pixel
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: An OpenEXR texture's pixels are unreadable, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Header in the subset, pixels unreadable (truncated file, unexpected compression, wrong chunk table)
messages.action: Export the OpenEXR file again with a standard compression.

messages.message: A Radiance HDR texture's header is unreadable, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Radiance HDR header missing, truncated, or without a valid resolution line
messages.action: Export the HDR file again.

messages.message: A Radiance HDR pixel encoding outside RGBE was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Pixel encoding outside the subset (`32-bit_rle_xyze`, another colour space)
messages.action: Export the image in the RGBE encoding.

messages.message: A Radiance HDR scan order other than top-down was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Scan order other than `-Y height +X width`; accepting it would flip the image
messages.action: Export the image with the standard `-Y height +X width` orientation.

messages.message: A Radiance HDR texture's scanlines are incomplete, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Scanlines cut short, a run overflowing its line, or a packet not advancing
messages.action: Export the HDR file again.

messages.message: A Radiance HDR texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Over the allocation ceiling, counted at 16 bytes per pixel
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: A KTX2 texture's header is truncated, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Shorter than its 80-byte header and level index require
messages.action: Export the KTX2 texture again.

messages.message: A KTX2 texture's header is out of range, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Header out of domain (bad identifier, zero width, unexpected `typeSize`, absurd level count, level starting inside the index)
messages.action: Export the KTX2 texture again.

messages.message: A KTX2 pixel format outside the read list was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A `vkFormat` outside the declared list (signed BC4/BC5/EAC, BC6H float, byte orders other than RGBA, channels wider than 8 bits, ASTC footprints other than 4x4)
messages.action: Export the texture with an 8-bit RGBA, BC or 4x4 ASTC format.

messages.message: A KTX2 cube, volume, array or 1D texture was refused, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Not a plain surface (1D texture, volume, layer array, cubemap)
messages.action: Export a plain 2D texture.

messages.message: A KTX2 supercompression other than none, BasisLZ or Zstandard was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A `supercompressionScheme` outside None, BasisLZ and Zstandard (ZLIB, unassigned numbers)
messages.action: Export the texture with BasisLZ, Zstandard or no supercompression.

messages.message: A KTX2 texture's level data is incomplete, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Consistent header, an announced level or its Zstandard stream incomplete
messages.action: Export the KTX2 texture again.

messages.message: A KTX2 texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: The image or its decompression buffer over the decoder's allocation ceiling
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: A Basis Universal payload could not be transcoded, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A Basis Universal payload the transcoder refuses (codec outside its list, video with cross-frame state, corrupt stream)
messages.action: Encode the texture again with a current Basis Universal encoder.

messages.message: A KTX2 orientation the reader cannot map was kept as stored, so the texture may appear flipped.
messages.cause: A `KTXorientation` not reducible to the contract's (top row first, left to right): starting leftwards, or a third dimension. `rd` (the contract's) and `ru` (flipped vertically) are handled; otherwise texels stay as stored
messages.action: Export the texture with the standard top-down, left-to-right orientation.

messages.message: A KTX2 channel swizzle was not applied.
messages.cause: A `KTXswizzle` other than the identity `rgba`; not applied
messages.action: Export the texture with its channels in RGBA order.

messages.message: An EAC-compressed KTX2 level is missing blocks, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A KTX2 level in an EAC format that does not carry all the blocks its dimensions announce.
messages.action: Export the KTX2 texture again.

messages.message: A Photoshop file's header is out of range, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Photoshop header out of domain (unknown version, non-zero reserved bytes, zero or over-ceiling side, channel count out of range or below its mode's colour channels)
messages.action: Save the file again from Photoshop, or export it as PNG.

messages.message: A Photoshop file at 1, 16 or 32 bits per channel was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: 1, 16 or 32 bits per channel, which `Rgba8` cannot hold; refused before decoding rather than narrowed
messages.action: Convert the document to 8 bits per channel.

messages.message: A Photoshop colour mode other than RGB or greyscale was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A mode outside RGB and greyscale (bitmap, indexed, CMYK, multichannel, duotone, Lab), whose conversion would need a profile, matrix or palette chosen in the source's stead
messages.action: Convert the document to RGB colour mode.

messages.message: A Photoshop file with several extra channels was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: More than one plane beyond the mode's colour channels; nothing says which is transparency, a saved selection or a spot colour
messages.action: Delete the extra channels, or export the texture as PNG.

messages.message: An extra Photoshop channel not declared as transparency was ignored.
messages.cause: One extra plane not declared transparency — the signed layer count Adobe's specification uses to say "the first alpha channel of the composite holds the document transparency" is absent or positive: a saved selection, read and written nowhere (taking it for transparency punched holes in the texture)
messages.action: Store transparency as a layer mask flattened into the composite, or export the texture as PNG.

messages.message: A layered Photoshop file was read as its flattened composite.
messages.cause: Layers present; only the flattened composite is delivered, since recomposing would redo the editor's blend modes, masks and effects
messages.action: Nothing to do if the saved composite is the image you want.

messages.message: A ZIP-compressed Photoshop composite was refused, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: A ZIP-compressed composite, outside the raw and PackBits subset
messages.action: Save the file without ZIP compression, or export it as PNG.

messages.message: A Photoshop file has no flattened composite, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: The file stops before its merged image data; layers are not recomposed instead
messages.action: Save the file with "Maximize compatibility" on, or export it as PNG.

messages.message: A Photoshop file's image data is incomplete, so the texture falls back to white.
messages.cause: Announced planes missing, or a compressed row short of its width
messages.action: Save the file again from Photoshop.

messages.message: A Photoshop texture is above the decoding size ceiling, so it falls back to white.
messages.cause: Over the decoder's allocation ceiling
messages.action: Reduce the texture's resolution.

messages.message: A texture could not be decoded, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image whose bytes the driver that recognised it could not decode (truncated or corrupt file).
messages.action: Open the image in an image editor and save it again as PNG.

messages.message: A texture has no pixels, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image of zero width or height, or a file with no image stream.
messages.action: Replace the texture with a non-empty image.

messages.message: A texture is in no format the image readers recognise, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: Image bytes no image driver claims.
messages.action: Convert the texture to PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: A texture file the model cites was not found, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image URI resolving to no readable file.
messages.action: Place the texture file where the model's URI points.

messages.message: A material names an image the file does not declare, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: A texture's image index past the glTF `images` array.
messages.action: Export the model again; its image list is inconsistent.

messages.message: A texture URI is absolute or leaves the model's folder, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image URI with a root, `..`, `.` or a platform separator.
messages.action: Use a URI relative to the model file, inside its folder.

messages.message: A texture URI resolves outside the model's folder, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image URI whose resolved path leaves the source folder.
messages.action: Move the texture into the model's folder.

messages.message: A texture URI has invalid percent-encoding, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image URI whose `%` escapes do not decode to UTF-8.
messages.action: Fix the URI's escaping in the model file.

messages.message: A glTF image has neither a URI nor a buffer view, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: A glTF `images` entry naming no data.
messages.action: Export the model again with its images embedded or referenced.

messages.message: A glTF image names an invalid buffer view, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image buffer view index that does not fit the published view table.
messages.action: Export the model again with its images embedded correctly.

messages.message: A glTF image's buffer view was not carried to the compiled source, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image buffer view absent from the view map of the compiled source.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the model if you can share it.

messages.message: A glTF image's buffer view reads past its buffer, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: An image buffer view whose range leaves its buffer.
messages.action: Export the model again; its buffer is truncated.

messages.message: A material names a texture the file does not declare, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: A material texture index past the glTF `textures` array.
messages.action: Export the model again; its texture list is inconsistent.

messages.message: A glTF texture names no image, so its texture levels are not baked.
messages.cause: A glTF `textures` entry with no `source`.
messages.action: Export the model again with the texture's image.

messages.message: A compressed texture level did not decode back during its quality check.
messages.cause: A block-compressed level the compiler encoded and then failed to decode for its quality check.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the texture if you can share it.

messages.message: The USDZ package stores an entry compressed or unaligned.
messages.cause: A USDZ entry compressed, or its payload not on a 64-byte boundary; the AOUSD package layout requires every file stored as-is and aligned
messages.action: Package the scene again with `usdzip` or a USD tool that writes the standard layout.

messages.message: The USDZ package's first entry is not a USD layer.
messages.cause: The package's first entry, its root layer, is not a USD layer, so it names no scene; later entries are resources, never candidate scenes
messages.action: Package the scene again with its root `.usd`, `.usda` or `.usdc` layer first.

messages.message: A point instancer was not expanded, so its instances are not drawn.
messages.cause: `PointInstancer`: parallel arrays over an indexed prototype, not expanded; does not fail the job
messages.action: Make the instances real in the authoring tool before exporting.

messages.message: Curves were left out; only surfaces are drawn.
messages.cause: `BasisCurves`, `NurbsCurves` or `HermiteCurves`: not a surface
messages.action: Convert the curves to meshes (for example tubes) before exporting.

messages.message: A volume was left out; only surfaces are drawn.
messages.cause: `Volume` or an OpenVDB/Field3D asset: not a surface
messages.action: Convert the volume to a mesh before exporting, if it should be drawn.

messages.message: A skeleton or blend shape was left out; the mesh is drawn in its rest pose.
messages.cause: `SkelRoot`, `Skeleton`, `SkelAnimation` or `BlendShape`: no skinning carried
messages.action: Export the model as glTF or FBX to keep its skinning.

messages.message: A camera was left out; the host places its own.
messages.cause: `Camera`: the host places its own
messages.action: Nothing to do; set the camera in your application.

messages.message: A light type with no glTF equivalent was left out.
messages.cause: A `UsdLux` schema with no glTF punctual equivalent — `DomeLight`, `CylinderLight`, `GeometryLight`, `PortalLight`, every `LightFilter`; sphere, disk, rect and distant lights are imported, with their declared emitter radius
messages.action: Replace it with a sphere, disk, rect or distant light.

messages.message: A NURBS patch was left out; it is not tessellated.
messages.cause: `NurbsPatch`: not tessellated
messages.action: Convert the patch to a mesh before exporting.

messages.message: A subdivision surface was carried as its flat polygons, which changes its silhouette.
messages.cause: A `Mesh` whose `subdivisionScheme` is not `none`: polygons carried **flat**, changing the silhouette
messages.action: Subdivide the mesh in the authoring tool before exporting, or set its scheme to `none`.

messages.message: Only the default selection of a variant set was read.
messages.cause: A variant set; only the composed default selection is read
messages.action: Select the variant you want as default before exporting.

messages.message: A reference, payload or sublayer could not be resolved.
messages.cause: A reference, payload or sublayer left unresolved (missing file, unresolvable path)
messages.action: Place the referenced file where the path points, or fix the path.

messages.message: An animated attribute was read at its first time sample; the scene is frozen there.
messages.cause: An attribute with no default read at its first time sample; the scene is frozen there
messages.action: Nothing to do for a still scene; export as glTF or FBX to keep the animation.

messages.message: A mesh's arrays are missing or contradictory, so it is left out.
messages.cause: Required `Mesh` arrays missing or contradictory (`faceVertexCounts` not landing on `faceVertexIndices`)
messages.action: Export the mesh again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: A polygon could not be cut into triangles cleanly and was filled as a fan.
messages.cause: As `blend-ngon-untriangulable`
messages.action: Triangulate or fix the face in the authoring tool (self-crossing or flat polygon).

messages.message: A transform operation was not composed.
messages.cause: A transform op not composed (`!resetXformStack!`, the inverse of an arbitrary matrix, an unknown op type)
messages.action: Flatten the transform stack in the authoring tool before exporting.

messages.message: A transform is not a finite number, so the node stays at identity.
messages.cause: Non-finite transform; the node stays at identity
messages.action: Fix the node's transform in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A material with no UsdPreviewSurface keeps default values.
messages.cause: A `Material` with no `UsdPreviewSurface` reachable from `outputs:surface`
messages.action: Give the material a UsdPreviewSurface shader.

messages.message: A texture was not found, is outside the model's folder, or is in an unread format.
messages.cause: A texture file absent, outside the source directory, or of a format the image registry does not read
messages.action: Place the texture in the model's folder as PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: An opacity image separate from the base colour was dropped; the written opacity is kept.
messages.cause: An `opacity` bound to an image the base colour does not carry; glTF reads alpha only in `baseColorTexture` and two images do not merge without recomposing a third, so the written opacity is kept and the image dropped
messages.action: Put the opacity into the alpha channel of the base-colour texture.

messages.message: A texture channel glTF does not read there was used; the map is carried as is.
messages.cause: An input bound to a channel glTF does not read there (metal from blue, roughness from green; an opacity on the base-colour image from alpha only); the map is carried as is, the opacity falls back to its written value
messages.action: Pack metalness in blue and roughness in green, and opacity in the base colour's alpha.

messages.message: A texture could not be bound as is.
messages.cause: A texture not bindable as is: a UV set other than `st`, a `<UDIM>` pattern, or split metallic/roughness maps
messages.action: Use the `st` UV set, no UDIM, and one texture for metalness and roughness.

messages.message: A wrap mode glTF lacks was replaced by repeat.
messages.cause: A `UsdUVTexture` wrap mode glTF lacks — `black` (transparent border) or `useMetadata`; the texture repeats, USD's default
messages.action: Use `repeat`, `mirror` or `clamp` wrap modes.

messages.message: A texture scale or bias glTF cannot carry was dropped.
messages.cause: A `scale` or `bias` no glTF factor carries (glTF multiplies, never adds): a non-zero `bias`, a `scale` differing across colour channels, or an alpha `scale` other than one
messages.action: Bake the scale and bias into the texture.

messages.message: A texture's colour space contradicts its role; its bytes pass through unchanged.
messages.cause: A `sourceColorSpace` contrary to the input's role (colour declared `raw`, data declared `sRGB`); bytes pass through, never re-encoded
messages.action: Declare colour textures `sRGB` and data textures `raw`.

messages.message: A specular-workflow material was read without its specular colour.
messages.cause: A specular-workflow `UsdPreviewSurface` (`useSpecularWorkflow`, or a written `specularColor`), which metal and roughness do not carry
messages.action: Convert the material to the metal-roughness workflow.

messages.message: A clearcoat layer was dropped; base glTF has none.
messages.cause: A clearcoat (`clearcoat` above zero, with its roughness): base glTF has no such layer
messages.action: Remove the clearcoat, or accept its loss.

messages.message: An index of refraction other than 1.5 was dropped.
messages.cause: An index of refraction other than 1.5: base glTF carries none
messages.action: Nothing carries it in glTF; set the look with roughness and metalness instead.

messages.message: A constant normal value was dropped; the geometry's normals stay.
messages.cause: A normal written as a value, no texture: glTF has no constant material normal, the geometry's stays
messages.action: Use a normal map texture instead of a constant.

messages.message: A face its arrays do not carry was dropped.
messages.cause: A face its arrays do not carry: index outside the points or negative, under three corners, or a primvar index outside its array; dropped, never folded onto the first point
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in the authoring tool and export again.

messages.message: A face listed as a hole was removed, as OpenUSD draws it.
messages.cause: A face in `holeIndices`, invisible in OpenUSD before any subdivision, so removed, once per face, whatever `subdivisionScheme`; a hole index outside the face table counts as `usd-face-invalid`
messages.action: Nothing to do; remove it from `holeIndices` if it should be drawn.

messages.message: The Alembic file uses the HDF5 container, which is not read.
messages.cause: HDF5 container instead of Ogawa, refused by name; re-export as Ogawa
messages.action: Export the file again as Alembic Ogawa.

messages.message: The Alembic archive was never closed by its writer.
messages.cause: No frozen flag: the writer never closed the archive, a work in progress
messages.action: Finish the export in the authoring tool, then compile the complete file.

messages.message: The Alembic file's format version is not read.
messages.cause: A format version this reader does not read (a 16-bit big-endian field, `00 01` for version one)
messages.action: Export the file again from a current authoring tool.

messages.message: The Alembic file is not a readable Ogawa archive.
messages.cause: No Ogawa header, block truncated, pointer outside the file, root group without its six blocks
messages.action: Export the file again; it is truncated or corrupt.

messages.message: An Alembic group or block is above the reader's size ceiling.
messages.cause: A group or data block beyond the plugin's allocation ceiling (4 Mi children, 1 GiB per block, 64 Mi face corners per mesh)
messages.action: Split the scene into smaller files.

messages.message: An Alembic transform stack does not compose.
messages.cause: An `Xform` op stack that does not compose: an op outside the format's seven, or fewer values than it consumes
messages.action: Export the file again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: An Alembic face points outside its positions.
messages.cause: A face index outside the position table, or more face corners declared than indices written
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in the authoring tool and export again.

messages.message: Alembic curves were left out; only meshes are drawn.
messages.cause: An Alembic curves object; not converted.
messages.action: Convert the curves to meshes before exporting.

messages.message: An Alembic point cloud was left out; only meshes are drawn.
messages.cause: An Alembic points object; not converted.
messages.action: Convert the points to meshes before exporting.

messages.message: An Alembic NURBS patch was left out; it is not tessellated.
messages.cause: An Alembic NURBS patch object; not converted.
messages.action: Convert the patch to a mesh before exporting.

messages.message: An Alembic camera was left out; the host places its own.
messages.cause: An Alembic camera object; not converted.
messages.action: Nothing to do; set the camera in your application.

messages.message: An Alembic light was left out.
messages.cause: An Alembic light object; not converted.
messages.action: Add the lights in the engine, or export the scene as glTF with its lights.

messages.message: An Alembic object of an unknown schema was left out.
messages.cause: An Alembic object whose schema the reader does not know; not converted.
messages.action: Convert the object to a mesh before exporting.

messages.message: An Alembic instance was left out.
messages.cause: An Alembic instance object; not expanded.
messages.action: Make the instances real in the authoring tool before exporting.

messages.message: An Alembic subdivision surface was drawn as its flat polygons.
messages.cause: A subdivision surface carried as its control polygons.
messages.action: Subdivide the mesh in the authoring tool before exporting.

messages.message: Only the first sample of an animated Alembic property was read.
messages.cause: A property with several time samples, read at its first.
messages.action: Nothing to do for a still scene; export as glTF or FBX to keep the animation.

messages.message: Alembic normals are missing, so they are computed.
messages.cause: A mesh with no normals written.
messages.action: Export the normals with the mesh if the computed ones look wrong.

messages.message: Alembic normals are inconsistent, so they are dropped and computed.
messages.cause: Normals whose count matches neither the vertices nor the face corners.
messages.action: Export the mesh again with one normal per vertex or per corner.

messages.message: Alembic UVs are inconsistent, so they are dropped.
messages.cause: UVs whose count or indices do not match the mesh.
messages.action: Export the mesh again with one UV per vertex or per corner.

messages.message: An Alembic face belongs to two face sets, so its material is ambiguous.
messages.cause: A face listed in two face sets.
messages.action: Assign each face to one face set.

messages.message: An Alembic face with fewer than three corners was dropped.
messages.cause: A face under three corners.
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in the authoring tool.

messages.message: A polygon could not be cut into triangles cleanly and was filled as a fan.
messages.cause: As `blend-ngon-untriangulable`.
messages.action: Triangulate or fix the face in the authoring tool (self-crossing or flat polygon).

messages.message: An Alembic face set could not be read, so it is skipped.
messages.cause: A face set with no readable face list.
messages.action: Export the mesh again with valid face sets.

messages.message: An Alembic mesh's arrays are contradictory, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A mesh whose counts, indices and positions disagree.
messages.action: Export the mesh again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: An Alembic mesh has no triangle, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A mesh with no face, or only degenerate ones.
messages.action: Delete the empty mesh or give it faces.

messages.message: An Alembic transform is not a finite number, so the node stays at identity.
messages.cause: A transform holding NaN or infinity.
messages.action: Fix the node's transform in the authoring tool.

messages.message: An Alembic transform that does not inherit its parent was placed at the scene root.
messages.cause: A transform flagged not to inherit its parent's; its subtree starts a new root.
messages.action: Nothing to do if the object should ignore its parent's transform.

messages.message: An Alembic hierarchy is deeper than the limit, so the deeper branch is cut.
messages.cause: A hierarchy past the reader's depth limit.
messages.action: Flatten the hierarchy in the authoring tool.

messages.message: The file is not a readable Maya ASCII file.
messages.cause: Does not open with `//Maya ASCII`, is not valid UTF-8, or stops inside a quoted string; refused, not read up to the break
messages.action: Save the file again from Maya as Maya ASCII.

messages.message: The Maya ASCII file or one of its attributes is above the size ceiling.
messages.cause: File above the 512 MiB ceiling, or an attribute index past the 16 Mi element ceiling
messages.action: Split the scene into smaller files.

messages.message: A MEL command outside the read subset was ignored; no command is ever run.
messages.cause: A MEL command outside the read subset, named after the two dots. **No command is ever executed**: `python`, `eval`, `source` and every unknown one land here, their text going to the report only
messages.action: Bake what the command builds into plain nodes before saving, or export to glTF.

messages.message: A Maya node type that is not converted was ignored.
messages.cause: A node type not converted — camera, light, NURBS surface, joint, script node, tool node
messages.action: Convert the node to a mesh before saving, or add the element in the engine.

messages.message: An attribute value names no node of the file, so it is ignored.
messages.cause: A `setAttr` with no node: no `createNode` or `select` before it, or the selection names no node of this file (Maya's defaults, `:time1` and the like, are not in the file)
messages.action: Nothing to do for Maya defaults; otherwise save the scene again.

messages.message: An attribute value is out of range or of an unread type, so it is ignored.
messages.cause: A `setAttr` whose values miss its index range, whose type is outside the read list, or whose index passes the element ceiling
messages.action: Save the scene again from Maya.

messages.message: A parenting command was not replayed.
messages.cause: A `parent` not replayed: not naming known mesh shapes and a known transform, or removing instead of adding
messages.action: Parent the shapes to their transforms in Maya before saving.

messages.message: A short node name is carried by several nodes; the first one written is used.
messages.cause: A name written without a path that several nodes carry, where Maya requires the full path (`|A|M`); the first node written answers
messages.action: Give the nodes unique names, or reference them by full path.

messages.message: A transform is not a finite number, so the node stays at identity.
messages.cause: Non-finite `transform`; the node stays at identity
messages.action: Fix the node's transform in Maya.

messages.message: A hierarchy is deeper than 256 levels or circular, so the branch is cut.
messages.cause: Deeper than 256 levels, a circular parent chain included; the branch is cut there without overflowing the stack
messages.action: Flatten the hierarchy in Maya.

messages.message: A matrix attribute not written as sixteen numbers was ignored.
messages.cause: A matrix attribute (`offsetParentMatrix`) not written as its sixteen numbers (`setAttr`'s long `xform` form); not guessed, the node keeps its other attributes' pose
messages.action: Bake the offset parent matrix into the transform before saving.

messages.message: An intermediate shape Maya never draws was left out.
messages.cause: An intermediate shape (`.io`), a construction-history input Maya never draws; left out. A shape with `visibility` off is left out too, counted as `invisible` like an invisible transform
messages.action: Nothing to do; delete construction history to remove it.

messages.message: A mesh's arrays are contradictory, so it is left out.
messages.cause: Contradictory `mesh` arrays: no `.vt`, a face corner outside the edge table, or an edge outside the vertex table
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in Maya (Mesh > Cleanup) and save again.

messages.message: A mesh has no triangle, so it is left out.
messages.cause: A `mesh` yielding no triangle: no face, or all degenerate
messages.action: Delete the empty mesh or give it faces.

messages.message: A face with fewer than three corners was dropped.
messages.cause: A face under three corners
messages.action: Clean up the mesh in Maya (Mesh > Cleanup).

messages.message: A face with a hole was left out.
messages.cause: A face declaring a hole (`h` record), which the fan would fill; the silhouette is not guessed
messages.action: Fill or cut the hole into regular faces in Maya.

messages.message: A polygon could not be cut into triangles cleanly and was filled as a fan.
messages.cause: As `blend-ngon-untriangulable`
messages.action: Triangulate or fix the face in Maya (self-crossing or flat polygon).

messages.message: An undocumented face record was ignored.
messages.cause: A `.fc` record the documentation does not describe
messages.action: Save the scene again from Maya.

messages.message: A face record attached to no face was ignored.
messages.cause: A `.fc` record attached to no face
messages.action: Save the scene again from Maya.

messages.message: UVs were dropped from a mesh part.
messages.cause: UVs dropped: a `mu` record with no face, a UV set past the first, a slot outside `.uvst[0].uvsp`, or a material part where only some faces carry UVs (a glTF primitive has an attribute on all its vertices or none)
messages.action: Give every face of the mesh UVs in the first UV set.

messages.message: Written normals did not match the mesh, so they are dropped and computed.
messages.cause: `.n` counts neither one vector per vertex nor one per corner; dropped, normals computed
messages.action: Save the mesh with one normal per vertex or per corner.

messages.message: No normals were written, so they are computed from the edges' hardness.
messages.cause: No normal written: computed from the geometry and each edge's hardness flag (the third number of `.ed`, a `.ma`'s only smoothing mark). A soft edge carries shading across, a hard edge splits it, one smooth fan's corners share a vertex. An edge shared by more than two faces joins nothing: incidences are counted over the whole topology, marks included, before any join, so no face or edge turns a three-face edge into a border and the file's face order does not matter
messages.action: Nothing to do if the shading looks right; otherwise set edge hardness in Maya.

messages.message: A material assignment names no face, so it is ignored.
messages.cause: An `instObjGroups` group whose component list names no face (a vertex, an edge, an empty list)
messages.action: Assign the material to faces in Maya.

messages.message: Faces with no material beside assigned ones were kept without a material.
messages.cause: Faces no `shadingGroup` claims beside bound faces of the same mesh; they leave in a material-less primitive, not dropped
messages.action: Assign a material to every face of the mesh.

messages.message: A shader other than lambert, phong, blinn or standardSurface keeps default values.
messages.cause: A shader other than `lambert`, `phong`, `blinn`, `standardSurface`
messages.action: Use one of those shaders.

messages.message: A coloured transparency was carried as one alpha, the mean of its channels.
messages.cause: A colour transparency with unequal channels; their mean is carried as the one alpha
messages.action: Use a grey transparency.

messages.message: An emission above 1 was clamped.
messages.cause: Emission above one, which `emissiveFactor` cannot carry; clamped
messages.action: Lower the emission, or accept the clamp.

messages.message: A texture was not found, is outside the model's folder, or is in an unread format.
messages.cause: A texture file absent, outside the source directory, or of a format the image registry does not read
messages.action: Place the texture in the model's folder as PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: A height bump map was dropped; glTF has no height map.
messages.cause: A `bump2d` reading a height relief (`bumpInterp` 0, Maya's default): glTF has no height map, and as `normalTexture` it would light the surface from an image saying nothing of orientation; the material keeps no `normalTexture`
messages.action: Convert the bump to a tangent-space normal map.

messages.message: An object-space normal map was dropped; glTF reads tangent-space normals.
messages.cause: A `bump2d` reading object-space normals (`bumpInterp` 2); glTF's `normalTexture` is tangent-space, and converting needs the pose at draw time
messages.action: Bake a tangent-space normal map.

messages.message: A texture placement (repeat, offset or rotation) was dropped.
messages.cause: A `place2dTexture` moving the placement (`repeatUV`, `offset`, `rotateUV`, whole or per component); `KHR_texture_transform` would carry it, but this glTF writer declares no such extension
messages.action: Bake the placement into the UVs in Maya.

messages.message: A texture mirroring was dropped.
messages.cause: A `place2dTexture` mirroring (`mirrorU`, `mirrorV`); no glTF wrap mode folds so
messages.action: Bake the mirroring into the UVs in Maya.

messages.message: A texture could not be bound as is.
messages.cause: A texture not bindable as is: an input computed rather than from a `file` node, a lone metalness or roughness map, or an opacity from another image than the base colour
messages.action: Use file textures, one texture for metalness and roughness, and opacity in the base colour's alpha.

messages.message: A referenced model's hierarchy does not compose, so its meshes are placed without transforms.
messages.cause: A referenced model whose hierarchy does not compose (a child index outside the node table, a node with two parents, a tree deeper than the limit); its meshes are instanced without transforms
messages.action: Export the model again from its authoring tool.

messages.message: A material declares both transparency and alpha clipping; transparency wins and the clip threshold is lost.
messages.cause: Transparency **and** alpha clipping declared (`_Mode`, `_Surface`, `_AlphaClip`/`_AlphaCutoffEnable`): `BLEND` wins, since `MASK` would make pixels fully opaque or drop them; the threshold is lost, glTF reading `alphaCutoff` only under `MASK`
messages.action: Choose either transparent or alpha-clipped rendering for the material.

messages.message: A prefab modification aimed at an object that is not drawn on its own was ignored.
messages.cause: A prefab-instance modification aimed at an object not rendered on its own (a model object folded into the instance root, or a second target competing for it); not mixed into another object's transform or materials
messages.action: Apply the modification inside the prefab.

messages.message: A prefab modification names a material slot beyond 65,536, so it is ignored.
messages.cause: A modification aimed at a material slot beyond the 65,536 a renderer carries
messages.action: Fix the modification in the Unity editor.

messages.message: A scene, prefab or material file could not be read.
messages.cause: A `.unity`, `.prefab` or `.mat` unreadable; the note names it
messages.action: Save the asset again from the Unity editor with text serialization.

messages.message: An object in a Unity file could not be parsed, so it is skipped.
messages.cause: A serialized object whose body does not parse in an otherwise readable file; skipped with the reason, the rest read
messages.action: Save the asset again from the Unity editor with text serialization.

messages.message: A Unity hierarchy is deeper than the limit, so the deeper branch is not built.
messages.cause: A transform hierarchy, nested prefabs included, deeper than the limit; the subtree is not built
messages.action: Flatten the hierarchy in the Unity editor.

messages.message: A transform value is not finite or a rotation has zero length, so identity is kept.
messages.cause: A non-finite local transform value or a zero-length rotation; identity kept
messages.action: Fix the transform in the Unity editor.

messages.message: A camera component was read as data and not drawn.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Nothing to do; set the camera in your application.

messages.message: A light component was not converted.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Add the lights in the engine, or export the scene as glTF with its lights.

messages.message: A particle system was not converted.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Rebuild the effect in the engine.

messages.message: A script component was read as data and not run.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Nothing to do; scripts are not part of a compiled scene.

messages.message: A skinned mesh renderer was not converted.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Export the character as FBX or glTF and compile it separately.

messages.message: A sprite renderer was not converted.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Replace the sprite with a textured quad mesh.

messages.message: A terrain was not converted.
messages.cause: A component read as data, not rendered (camera, light, particle system, script, skinned renderer, sprite renderer, terrain); never approximated
messages.action: Export the terrain as a mesh (for example with a terrain-to-mesh tool).

messages.message: A mesh stored inside the scene file was not read.
messages.cause: A `MeshFilter` pointing at a mesh stored in the scene file; no mesh bytes are read here
messages.action: Save the mesh as a model asset (FBX or OBJ) and reference it.

messages.message: A built-in primitive other than the cube was not converted.
messages.cause: An editor built-in primitive other than the cube (sphere, capsule, cylinder, plane), whose tessellation is the editor's; the note gives the `fileID`
messages.action: Replace it with a model asset of the same shape.

messages.message: A referenced model is not in the project.
messages.cause: A GUID no project asset carries
messages.action: Add the missing model asset to the project.

messages.message: A referenced material is not in the project.
messages.cause: A GUID no project asset carries
messages.action: Add the missing material asset to the project.

messages.message: A referenced texture is not in the project.
messages.cause: A GUID no project asset carries
messages.action: Add the missing texture asset to the project.

messages.message: A referenced prefab is not in the project.
messages.cause: A GUID no project asset carries
messages.action: Add the missing prefab asset to the project.

messages.message: A material file holds no material.
messages.cause: A `.mat` with no `Material` object
messages.action: Save the material again from the Unity editor.
