messages.message: A referenced model is in a format no driver reads.
messages.cause: A referenced model no driver claims
messages.action: Convert the model to FBX, OBJ or glTF.

messages.message: A referenced model is itself a Unity scene, which is not nested.
messages.cause: A referenced model that is itself a Unity scene: a driver does not call itself
messages.action: Reference the scene's content as a prefab instead.

messages.message: A referenced model could not be imported; the note carries its reason.
messages.cause: The model's driver refused it; the note carries its code and message
messages.action: Fix the model as its own message says, then compile again.

messages.message: A referenced model's imported data could not be read.
messages.cause: The imported model's glTF, or a buffer, unreadable
messages.action: Delete the cache folder and compile again.

messages.message: A mesh of a multi-mesh model could not be found by its id, so the whole model is placed.
messages.cause: A `MeshFilter` naming one mesh of a multi-mesh model by a `fileID` its `.meta` does not name, or an object the model lacks; the whole model is instanced, no part guessed
messages.action: Reimport the model in Unity so its `.meta` names every mesh.

messages.message: A packed metallic-smoothness map was not converted; the factors are kept.
messages.cause: Metal and smoothness packed in one plane (R and A, or the HDRP mask) where glTF wants G and B; converting would re-encode pixels, so the factors are kept exactly
messages.action: Author a glTF-style map (roughness in green, metalness in blue).

messages.message: A texture in a format the image readers do not decode was dropped.
messages.cause: A texture format the image registry does not claim; dropped
messages.action: Convert the texture to PNG or JPEG.

messages.message: A texture outside the project's served folder was not copied.
messages.cause: A texture outside the served root, which no URI names
messages.action: Move the texture into the project folder.

messages.message: A texture's tiling or offset was dropped.
messages.cause: A non-neutral UV scale or offset on a slot, which needs an extension the intermediate scene does not write yet
messages.action: Bake the tiling and offset into the UVs or the texture.

messages.message: A wrap mode glTF lacks (Mirror Once) was replaced by repeat.
messages.cause: A `TextureImporter` wrap mode glTF lacks (_Mirror Once_); the axis repeats
messages.action: Use Repeat, Clamp or Mirror wrap modes.

messages.message: A texture filter outside point, bilinear and trilinear was replaced by the default.
messages.cause: A `TextureImporter` filter outside point, bilinear and trilinear; glTF default kept
messages.action: Use point, bilinear or trilinear filtering.

messages.message: An HDR emission above 1 was clamped.
messages.cause: An emissive colour above 1 (Unity's HDR emission), `emissiveFactor` being bounded to [0, 1]
messages.action: Lower the emission intensity, or accept the clamp.

messages.message: A material stores an emission colour but does not enable emission, so it does not glow.
messages.cause: Keywords declared without `_EMISSION` beside a stored emissive colour: it does not emit
messages.action: Enable Emission on the material if it should glow.

messages.message: A component a prefab instance adds was not converted.
messages.cause: A component a prefab instance adds to a source object; it lives in the instance's document, not folded into the source object
messages.action: Add the component inside the prefab itself.

messages.message: An object a prefab instance adds under an undrawn object was kept under the instance root.
messages.cause: An object a prefab instance adds under a source object not rendered; kept under the instance root
messages.action: Add the object inside the prefab itself.

messages.message: A prefab modification that changes neither geometry nor rendering was ignored.
messages.cause: A modification changing neither geometry nor rendering, counted by property (array indices reduced to `[]`, keeping the report bounded)
messages.action: Nothing to do.

messages.message: The compiler has no build for this operating system and processor.
messages.cause: `process.platform` and `process.arch` name a pair outside the supported list.
messages.action: Compile on one of the supported platforms the message lists, or set `TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN` to a compiler you built yourself.

messages.message: The compiler program is missing.
messages.cause: No compiler program where the Node adapter looked: `options.executable`, the installed platform package `@trillion3d/compiler-<platform>-<arch>` (an optional dependency of `trillion3d`; none serves a Linux on musl), or `TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN`.
messages.action: Reinstall `trillion3d` with its optional dependencies, or set `TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN` to the path of a compiler program.

messages.message: The compiler program exists but cannot be run.
messages.cause: The operating system refused to start the executable (no execute permission).
messages.action: Reinstall `trillion3d`, or make the file named by `TRILLION3D_COMPILER_BIN` executable (`chmod +x`).

messages.message: The compiler built in this checkout is older than its sources.
messages.cause: A crate source newer than the checkout's release build; its caches would carry the previous build's key. Raised only inside a checkout of the Trillion3D repository.
messages.action: Run `pnpm run build:native` in the checkout.

messages.message: The compiler printed a line longer than the protocol allows, so the run was stopped.
messages.cause: A stderr or stdout line past 4 MiB without an end of line.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug.

messages.message: The compiler ended without printing where its result is.
messages.cause: Exit code 0 with no readable pointer on stdout.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the events it printed.

messages.message: The compiler reported a result that is not ready.
messages.cause: A pointer whose `status` is not `ready` and carries no code.
messages.action: Read the events of the run for the job's error, then compile again.

messages.message: The compiler stopped with an unexpected exit code and no error code.
messages.cause: A non-zero exit with no pointer, no batch summary and no error event.
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the exit code and the events it printed.

messages.message: The compile succeeded with warnings, which `--strict` turns into a failure.
messages.cause: `trillion3d-compile --strict` saw at least one warning-level message; the cache is written, the exit code is 3.
messages.action: Fix what the warnings say, or run without `--strict`.

messages.message: The cutout answer sheet is not one this version reads.
messages.cause: The sheet file is not an answer sheet, or declares another version.
messages.action: Delete the answer sheet in the cache folder and compile again to write a new one.

messages.message: A PNG image is not a whole 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced file.
messages.cause: The Node adapter's PNG reader (cutout previews, reference images) reads 8-bit RGBA, non-interlaced PNG files only, every row present.
messages.action: Save the image again as 8-bit RGBA without interlacing; for a cutout preview, delete the cache folder's cutout previews and compile again.

messages.message: An optional family of the browser engine did not load.
messages.cause: The chunk of a family the page uses (physics, particles, transmission, deformation, effects, guides, diagnostics, measurement, world stream, impostors, WebGPU renderer, WebGL2 renderer) failed to import twice in a row, as the engine's HTTP loader asks a file twice: a network drop, a CDN that does not answer, or a chunk missing from the served folder. `details.family` names the family; the frames that draw with it wait for it, and a session whose renderer does not arrive does not open, refused with this error.
messages.action: Check that every chunk of the bundle is served beside the entry module and reachable; the engine asks the family again on its next use.

messages.message: The world roots' table could not be written as its records.
messages.cause: A world-roots table whose page, bundle, cluster or group names a value its fixed-size record cannot hold (a word past 32 bits, a missing field, a digest that is not 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits); the message names the field ([World super-roots](FORMAT.md#world-super-roots)).
messages.action: Report it as a compiler bug, with the field the message names.
